criteria.name: correct-answer
criteria.semanticPrompt: The response must correctly identify wether the discount applies or not based on the number of books bought: 4 or more books = discount, less than 4 books = no discount

criteria.name: correct-answer
criteria.semanticPrompt: Response includes the correct intermediate calculations: 1) if identifies 4 or more books, then number of books x 3 = total cost, 25% of total cost = discount, total cost - discount = final cost. If identifies less than 4 books, then number of books x 3 = total cost.
